title: The protection check for `maxBetShare` can be gamed
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium, because a protocol invariant can be broken and the code gives a false sense of security  **Likelihood:** Medium, as it can easily be gamed but there is no incentive for an attacker  ## Description  The `lockLiquidity` method tries to block a single bet from taking up too much of the LP's allowed liquidity limit, but this can be gamed by splitting a very large bet into a big number of smaller ones, so this `LargeBet` custom error check would give a false sense of security as it doesn't guarantee what it intended to.  ## Recommendations  Change the validation to
